description: A coalition of European member states, alarmed by repeated denials of frontier access and semiconductor coercion, begins informal coordination with Japan and South Korea to create a mutual access pact for AI development resources and secure supply-chain nodes. The move is framed as resilience-building but signals a shift toward strategic autonomy from U.S. tech policy. It gains traction due to the EU's upstream leverage in lithography and materials, even if sovereignty remains low.
